_readme: Add a new object to the start of entries (newest first). Use a unique version string (e.g. 2025-08-19) so the unread dot clears after members open What's new. Keep summary to one sentence.

entries.summary: Added an in-app What's new page so you can see recent product updates without leaving the app.
Leaderboard now ranks members by semester attendance with filters for Spring and Fall.
Friends list and event interest let you see who plans to attend upcoming chapter events.
Check-in supports QR scan, six-character codes, and admin manual check-in at events.
Dashboard shows your 111 and 333 achievement progress for the current semester.
